title: ScaleMultiplierRequest
description: Scale the multiplier of a Dynawo Updatable (UpdatableDiscrete/UpdatableContinuous) associated with an IIDM element, directly in Dynawo, without needing to know the element's current value

multiplier_increase.description: Signed relative change applied to the element's current multiplier (e.g. -0.05 to decrease it by 5% of its current value)
